snippet.title: BRINGING FUN BACK to Racing Games - Race Jam Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST TODAY!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3474450/Race_Jam/

Race Jam: Exhilarating 90's Arcade Racing like you remember, But BETTER

Join our Discord - https://discord.gg/bE5RArtmfh

Jam packed with content: Featuring 6 Game Modes, including 90's Tour a full single player campaign with over 99 missions to complete and Gauntlet a roguelike mode where you have to win a race on every track consecutively while unlocking perks and bonuses along the way

Customize to your playstyle - Build your own Race Kits to enhance your vehicles with upgraded parts, or just to show off the new rims and spoilers you’ve unlocked!

Race with Friends: Up to 4 players can hop on the couch and race for bragging rights. Or hop online and compete against people from all over the world.

Easy to race, tough to master: Switch on Dad mode for a fun casual experience. Or more experienced players can use advanced techniques such as boost cancels, perfect boosts and more allow for more skill expression then any racing game that has come before.
